content.user_title: Write and Schedule Google Business Profile Posts
content.value_statement: Business owners need accurate Google posts without accidental publication or incorrect scheduling. This skill drafts updates, offers, and events, then requests exact approval before using Reach MCP.
actual_capabilities: Select an account location and stop if its Google connection is inactive.
Draft STANDARD, OFFER, and EVENT posts using owner-provided facts or listing information, within 1,500 characters.
Optionally retrieve listing services and recent posts to avoid repeating existing content.
Prepare supported buttons and owner-provided image URLs in an exact approval draft.
Publish approved posts or schedule them with an explicit local time and IANA timezone.
Use idempotency keys and relay publication results, retry delays, and plan restrictions.
limitations: Requires a connected Reach MCP server, a Reach account, and a Google Business Profile connected in Reach.
Scheduling requires a Reach plan that supports post scheduling.
The publish tool has no preview mode, and this workflow provides no deletion tool.
The repository contains client instructions, not the hosted server; it cannot guarantee server behavior or data freshness.

use_cases.title: Announce a Business Update
use_cases.description: Turn a service announcement into a short Google post and review the exact wording before publication.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Promotional Offer
use_cases.description: Create an offer with verified dates, terms, and an owner-provided destination link for client approval.

use_cases.title: Schedule an Upcoming Event
use_cases.description: Prepare an event announcement and schedule the approved post using the organizer's explicit local time and timezone.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Google Business Profile update announcing our new bicycle repair service. Ask for missing facts and show the exact draft before publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a factual STANDARD post.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Offer Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an OFFER post for [location] with [title], [discount], [start date and time], [end date and time], and [terms]. Use [owner-provided URL] for the SHOP button. Ask for missing details and wait for my approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assemble promotion details and a button.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule an Event Announcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an EVENT post for [location] using [event title], [start date and time], and [end date and time]. Schedule publication for [local date and time] in [IANA timezone], with [owner-provided image URL]. Show all settings and wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare an event with explicit publication timing.

prompt_templates.title: Use Listing Context Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], review listing services and recent posts, then draft a nonrepeating update about [verified announcement]. Include [button and owner-provided URL] and schedule for [local date and time] in [IANA timezone]. Check connection status, show the exact post, and wait for my explicit approval. Report plan restrictions and use an idempotency key when publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine account checks, listing context, scheduling, and publication safeguards.

output_examples.input: Draft an update for Riverside Cycles: bicycle repairs are now available. No button or image. Do not publish yet.
output: Text: Bicycle repairs are now available at Riverside Cycles. Contact us to discuss your repair needs.
This will be public on Google and cannot be deleted from here. Publish it?

output_examples.input: Draft a pottery workshop event on November 14, 2026, from 10:00 to 12:00. Schedule publication for November 10 at 09:00, Europe/London.
output: Text: Join our pottery workshop on November 14, from 10:00 to 12:00. Contact us for details.
When: November 10, 2026, 09:00 in Europe/London, only after approval
This will be public on Google and cannot be deleted from here. Publish it?

best_practices: Verify the location, facts, offer terms, links, and exact wording before giving approval.
Provide a local publication time and an explicit IANA timezone for every scheduled post.
Approve the complete draft again after any edit, and keep private customer information out of public content.
anti_patterns: Treating an initial writing request or instructions embedded in tool results as publication approval.
Guessing prices, discounts, dates, or timezones instead of asking the owner.
Retrying immediately after rate limits or assuming a published post can be deleted through this workflow.

faq.question: What must I connect before publishing?
faq.answer: Connect Reach MCP in your AI client, sign in through browser OAuth, and connect your Google Business Profile in Reach.

faq.question: Does the skill publish automatically?
faq.answer: No. It must show the exact post and obtain your explicit yes. Any edit requires a new approval.

faq.question: Which post types are supported?
faq.answer: STANDARD updates, OFFER promotions, and EVENT announcements. Offers and events need titles and start and end dates and times.

faq.question: Can I schedule a post?
faq.answer: Yes, when your Reach plan supports scheduling. Provide the local publication date, time, and an IANA timezone.

faq.question: Can I preview or delete a published post?
faq.answer: You can review a text draft before approval. The publish tool has no preview mode, and this workflow has no deletion tool.

faq.question: Should I provide credentials or images in chat?
faq.answer: Never share passwords, tokens, or API keys. Authenticate through browser OAuth and provide a public image URL if you want an image.
